info.description: OpenAPI specification of the inventory microservice

qty.description: Quantity to issue in base unit (NUMERIC(18,3))

items.description: If omitted, receives the full remaining in-transit quantity for all lines

resolveDiscrepancy.description: If true, marks a transfer with recorded discrepancy as resolved (RECEIVED)

skuIds.description: Optional list of SKU UUIDs to snapshot immediately

refreshSnapshot.description: If true, refreshes snapshot version to current stock_balance version when recording counts

forceRebase.description: Default false: rejects with 409 STOCKTAKE_STALE_SNAPSHOT if stock moved since snapshot was captured

unitCost.description: Agreed unit cost per base unit (integer VND)

qty.description: Base quantity received in this shipment (NUMERIC(18,3))

unitCost.description: Optional unit cost override (defaults to PO line unitCost) (integer VND)

items.description: If omitted, receives the full remaining unreceived quantity for all PO lines

orderId.description: Order UUID used as the reservation idempotency key

qty.description: Quantity in packaging or base unit (NUMERIC(18,3))

unitCost.description: Unit cost per base unit (integer VND)

autoPost.description: If true, immediately posts the receipt in the same transaction
